title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A rich and classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, Pecorino cheese, guanciale, and black pepper. Ready in under 30 minutes!
instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions.
Dice the guanciale and fry it in a pan until crispy. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs, grated cheese, and plenty of black pepper.
Drain the spaghetti, reserving some pasta water.
Quickly mix the spaghetti with the egg mixture, guanciale, and pasta water to create a creamy sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Tender chunks of grilled chicken cooked in a smooth, buttery, and creamy tomato-based gravy. A popular and comforting Indian-British fusion dish.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or bake the chicken until cooked through.
Sauté chopped onion, then add ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer.
Add the cooked chicken and cream. Simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with rice or naan.

title: Ultimate Beef Tacos
summary: Simple, flavourful ground beef tacos seasoned perfectly and served in warm corn tortillas with your favourite toppings.
instructions: Brown the ground beef and drain any excess fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water. Bring to a simmer and cook until the water has reduced.
Spoon the beef mixture into the tortillas and top with lettuce, salsa, and cheese.
